text:
alex: heads up — planning a short canary for release v2.3.1 in 10m. want to pin model-serving to 2.3.1-rc before we route traffic. will do a quick smoke and metrics check.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy request accepted for v2.3.1 -> canary-cluster-3. starting in 9m. pinned-version: none currently.
maya: can we pin the fallback to 2.2.9-hotfix just in case? last rollback took a while.
samir: +1 on fallback pin. also note the DB migration flag is off for this canary — no schema changes, right?
alex: no schema changes, just inference runtime and quantization tweaks. fallback pin to 2.2.9-hotfix sounds good. i'll add the pin before kicking off.
jen: sharing release notes: https://confluence/redwood/release/v2.3.1 — contains perf notes and known issues (small mem bump on 4k sequences). verify observability dashboards after canary.
alex: pin applied -> runtime.pin=model-serving:2.2.9-hotfix. starting canary now.
deploy-bot: canary start: v2.3.1 -> canary-cluster-3. instances: 4. health checks initiated. rollout policy: 10% traffic -> canary. logs: `kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/model-serving-canary`
maya: watching logs. if error rate > 0.5% in first 5m we stop.
samir: quick rollback command if needed: `infractl deploy rollback --service model-serving --to 2.2.9-hotfix --reason "canary fail"`
deploy-bot: canary metrics (5m): latency P95 112ms (+8ms), errors 0.12%, memory +6%. health: green.
jen: looks good from observability end. run a couple stress samples against the canary endpoint.
alex: running smoke + 50 request burst now.
deploy-bot: smoke logs: all requests 200s, kv-cache hit rate 74%. stress burst: error spike to 0.6% for 30s then recovered to 0.15%.
maya: saw the 30s spike. is that the quantization path warming? can we throttle the ramp?
samir: suggest holding the rollout at 10% for another 15m and increase only if stable. also notify support on standby.
alex: holding at 10%. i'll open a tiny note in the change window doc.
jen: change window reminder — freeze until 22:30 UTC; final ops sign-off by 22:10. we still have time.
deploy-bot: canary stable after 20m. recommended next step: gradual increase to 50% over 10m. to proceed, react with :thumbsup:.
alex: :thumbsup: proceeding with 50% ramp.
maya: :thumbsup: support notified.
samir: if error rate creeps above 0.5% at any point auto-rollback to pinned 2.2.9-hotfix will trigger.
deploy-bot: ramp to 50% started. will report final status.
alex: notes for post-deploy checklist: update rollout notes, add perf deltas to release notes, confirm no regressions on customer-facing routes, and schedule 1h follow-up.
deploy-bot: ramp complete: 50% traffic, errors 0.14%, P95 115ms. deployment marked canary-success.
jen: thanks all. leaving final sign-off to samir for DB/infra.
samir: sign-off given for full rollout. proceed with production cadence at 00:00 UTC in change window.
alex: thanks team — will open production rollout ticket and paste commands here.
deploy-bot: ticket created: #INFER-4021.
